description: Major capability inventory (#764 §1.1 coverage seed, reconciled against live repository reality at SOURCE_SHA). Reconciliation values: SAME/RENAMED/SPLIT/MERGED/NOT_APPLICABLE (a coverage-seed disposition, NOT an IR mapping_state value). Deep-review sample beyond the golden slices: candidate exam runtime (candidate-facing + durable state), audit (operational), proctoring (authorization-heavy), operations/diagnostics (operational + authorization boundary). Support verdicts stay UNKNOWN except where golden-slice claims establish them — mapping coverage is this inventory's deliverable, never a support claim.
